Global Energy Monitor (2026). Global Cement and Concrete Tracker, July 2026 (V1) release, plant-level data (standard copy). https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-cement-and-concrete-tracker/ (accessed 2026-11-11).

HELD LOCALLY since 2026-11-11 (gem-data.zip). One row per cement plant: cement and clinker capacity, 2024-2025 cement production (few plants), kiln count and kiln technology flags. Loaded by gem_extract.py: clinker capacity per kiln for precalciner and for wet or semi-dry kilns, cement capacity per plant by majority cement type, and the cement-plant capacity factor. Scope rule: Canada where three or more plants report the value, else North America, else global (Brad 2026-11-11). Traps: capacities are in million tonnes (x1000 to kt/yr); clinker capacity is per plant, so it is divided by the number of existing kilns (every Canadian plant has one); kiln technology is often 'unknown' (11 of 20 Canadian plants for the precalciner), and those plants are left out of the kiln sizes; GEM prints no production for any Canadian or US plant. The Canadian roster with shares is in _canada-stock.csv (for calibrating CIMS shares later, not loaded).
